newsitem.title: USA: CompuServe offers e-mail over phone in UK.
newsitem.headline: CompuServe offers e-mail over phone in UK.

text.p: CompuServe Corp's U.K. online service unit and Premiere Technologies Inc said Thursday they would offer an electronic mail service over the telephone for customers in Britain.

CompuServe said its online service unit's partnership with Premiere will enable U.K. CompuServe members, which now number in excess of 400,000, to send and receive e-mail from any phone whether or not they have access to a personal computer.
The service, which has been in place in the United States for several months, will allow CompuServe/Premiere subscribers to receive and respond to e-mail messages from any telephone.
Premiere is a telecoms and information systems integrator based in Atlanta. CompuServe is based in Columbus, Ohio.
CompuServe Interactive said it will offer U.K. members a communications card to give subscribers access to the system in early 1997.

Upon receipt of an electronic mail message, the CompuServe subscriber can instruct the system to fax the message to any specified fax machine -- or the message can be read to the subscriber via a text-to-voice synthesizer.
The subscriber will be able to respond to the e-mail by choosing a variety of standard responses.

In addition to electronic mail, Premiere's system integrates services that include worldwide long distance phone service and a universal mailbox that allows users to receive and retrieve both text and voice messages.
It also allows users to be notified of pager messages, news headlines, sports updates and weather reports, receive travel assistance and conduct conference calls.
Premiere stock was up 1-1/4 to 24 at midday Thursday.

CompuServe, which earlier Thursday announced a large loss for its second quarter ended in October and plans to discontinue several consumer marketing efforts in the United States, was off 3/4 at 10-7/8.
